tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Blue Leopard Media's website: services, prices, case studies, insights (articles on PR, ads and music marketing) and company pages. Returns page ids, titles and URLs; read a page with fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read the full text of a Blue Leopard Media page by its id (from search) or its URL on blueleopardmedia.com.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Facts about Blue Leopard Media: what it does, founding year, markets, mailing address, email and WhatsApp, services with their pages, and official profiles.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Blue Leopard Media's current prices in USD: editorial feature packages on its publications, how Google and Meta Ads are priced, and the pricing page text.

tools.name: list_publications
tools.description: The business, lifestyle and entertainment publications where Blue Leopard Media places editorial features.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Send an enquiry to Blue Leopard Media for the user. Only use it when the user asks to get in touch, with their own name and email (never invented). Confirm the details with the user before sending. The team replies by email within one business day.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_company_info, submit_enquiry · Public sink: get_company_info, submit_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_company_info, submit_enquiry · Public sink: get_company_info, submit_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
